description: Send a message to another agent: your parent (`..`), one of your children (its name), a sibling (`../name`) or any agent below you (its path, as list_agents shows it). You can't message your parent's parent or a sibling's children: ask your parent to pass it on. The recipient sees only this text, never your conversation, so make it complete. A running recipient reads it at its next step; an idle one is woken to read it, unless wake is false, when it waits until the recipient next runs. A message with wake on to your own child is a new task, and the child reports back when it is done. To ask your parent or a sibling something, send the question and end your reply: the answer arrives as a message, so don't poll for it. Siblings can exchange only a limited number of messages before their parent writes to them again. Hand in your own result with report, not with a message.

to.description: The recipient: `..` for your parent, a child's name, `../name` for a sibling, or the path of an agent below you.

wake.description: false lets an idle recipient read it when it next runs instead of waking it. true when left out.

name: send_message
